definitions.R1_h264_crf23: per-window libx264 yuv420p medium CRF 23 roundtrip at 8 FPS
definitions.R2_h264_crf35: per-window libx264 yuv420p medium CRF 35 roundtrip at 8 FPS
definitions.R3_resize_half_restore: 0.5 area downscale followed by cubic restore
definitions.R4_drop10: drop round(0.10*T) hash-ranked sampled frames without replacement
definitions.R5_drop25: drop round(0.25*T) hash-ranked sampled frames without replacement
definitions.R6_repeat10: replace round(0.10*T) hash-ranked positions by the preceding frame
definitions.R7_repeat25: replace round(0.25*T) hash-ranked positions by the preceding frame
definitions.R8_scene_cut: first half target plus second half fixed same-group donor; donor windows are matched by normalized temporal position, with the middle donor window used for K=1
definitions.R9_4fps: take positions 0,2,...,14 from each locked 16-frame window
